About Radture

Shaping the future of medical imaging, one report at a time.

Radture is built by Ultradeck Labs to connect hospitals, imaging centers and radiologists, so every scan moves from acquisition to a signed report without delay.

Who we are

Built for hospitals and imaging centers.

Radture brings workflow automation and seamless PACS integration to radiology. Built for hospitals and imaging centers, it improves efficiency, speeds up reporting and keeps radiology reports accurate and structured.

The platform supports radiologists with AI-assisted reporting, smart worklist management and automated follow-up tracking, enabling faster diagnoses and better patient outcomes. With Radture, healthcare providers can streamline operations, enhance collaboration and deliver high-quality care.

Impact & commitment

We free radiologists to focus on what matters most: precise diagnoses and better patient outcomes.

Radture is dedicated to transforming radiology through workflow automation, seamless collaboration and patient-centered innovation. By streamlining workflows, reducing reporting time and ensuring accurate, structured reports, we help radiology teams deliver care with confidence.

Our commitment goes beyond technology. We strive to enhance healthcare accessibility, support radiology professionals, and enable hospitals to provide faster, more efficient care. With continuous advancements and a focus on real-world impact, Radture is shaping the future of medical imaging, one report at a time.

Why Radture

What we bring to every imaging team.

Results

We deliver results

Radture’s AI-powered reporting reduces dictation time by up to 50% and saves radiologists over 60 minutes per shift. By automating structured impressions and follow-up recommendations, we increase efficiency, improve accuracy and help hospitals capture missed revenue opportunities.

Usability

Our platform is easy to use

Built by health-tech engineers and AI specialists working closely with radiologists, Radture enhances efficiency without disrupting existing workflows. With zero-click AI assistance, radiologists don’t have to change how they work.

Partnership

We’re a trusted partner

With deep expertise in healthcare technology, Radture is built to meet the growing demands of radiology. We collaborate closely with hospitals, imaging centers and radiologists to streamline workflows, improve patient care and create a smarter radiology ecosystem.

Impression

Choose Radture for connected imaging workflows.

From in-house reporting to cross-facility referrals, Radture provides a shared imaging workflow backbone that connects hospitals, diagnostic centers and specialists — reducing delays, removing manual handoffs, and enabling faster, more coordinated care.
